import copy,hashlib,json,math,os,statistics
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch
import torch
from PIL import Image
from scripts import native_comparator as worker
from crope.rope import FluxRoPE
from crope.runtime import fingerprint,implementation_hash
torch.set_num_threads(2)
root=Path.cwd();notes=root/'.agent/notes/native_cr20'
def read(p):return json.loads(Path(p).read_text())
def sha(p):
 with Path(p).open('rb') as f:return hashlib.file_digest(f,'sha256').hexdigest()
def th(t):return hashlib.sha256(t.contiguous().view(torch.uint8).numpy().tobytes()).hexdigest()
protocol_path=root/'.agent/notes/native_comparator_protocol.json'
protocol=read(protocol_path)
submission=read(root/'.agent/notes/native_comparator_submission.json')
assert sha(protocol_path)==submission['protocol_sha256']
assert submission['job_id']=='1077304'
report=read(notes/'report.json')
assert report['protocol_sha256']==sha(protocol_path) and report['accepted'] and report['images']==8
assert report['reporter_sha256']==sha(root/'scripts/native_comparator_report.py')
for p,h in protocol['source_sha256'].items():assert sha(root/p)==h,p
for name in (*worker.PINNED,'rubric','presentation','cr14_model_manifest'):
 assert sha(protocol[name]['path'])==protocol[name]['sha256']
for name,count in [('cr18_protocol',16),('cr19_protocol',15)]:
 old=read(protocol[name]['path'])
 assert len(old['source_sha256'])==count
 for p,h in old['source_sha256'].items():assert sha(root/p)==h,p
accepted=read(protocol['accepted_cr18_report']['path'])['raw_json']['prompt0']['manifest.json']
captions=worker.read_prompts(protocol['prompt_file']['path'])[:8]
archive=Path('/work/09032/saini_2/vista/results/constancy_rope/native_cr20_job1077304')
assert read(archive/'manifest.json')==report
assert archive.resolve()==archive and not archive.is_symlink()
retained={x['source']:x for x in report['retained']}
assert len(retained)==40
total=0
for source,entry in retained.items():
 p=Path(entry['preserved'])
 assert p.is_relative_to(archive) and not p.is_symlink() and p.resolve()==p
 assert sha(p)==entry['sha256']==sha(source)
 assert p.stat().st_size==entry['bytes']
 total+=p.stat().st_size
assert total==report['retained_bytes']
outcomes=[];manifests=[]
native_rope=FluxRoPE(method='sega_official',grid=(64,64)).metadata()
common_config_keys=('model','model_revision','dtype','batch_size','attention','diffusers','torch','eta','target','temperature','profile_sha256','static_profile_sha256','probe_band','probe_factor','scale_choice')
for chunk,(start,end) in enumerate(protocol['chunks']):
 directory=Path(submission['watcher_registration']['progress_dirs'][chunk])
 manifest=read(directory/'manifest.json');done=read(directory/'completion.json')
 assert not (directory/'failure.json').exists()
 assert manifest==report['raw'][str(chunk)]['manifest'] and done==report['raw'][str(chunk)]['completion']
 assert manifest['start']==done['start']==start and manifest['end']==done['end']==end
 assert manifest['slurm_job_id']==submission['job_id']
 assert manifest['prompt_ids']==[r['id'] for r in captions[start:end]]
 assert manifest['scope']==done['scope']==worker.FIXED['scope']
 assert manifest['noise_coupling']==done['noise_coupling']==worker.FIXED['noise_coupling']
 assert manifest['new_method'] is done['new_method'] is False
 assert manifest['model']==accepted['model']
 assert manifest['native_rope']==native_rope
 assert manifest['seed_device']=='cpu' and manifest['seed_policy']=='crope.utils.image_seed(prompt_id,0)'
 for k in ('torch','cuda','diffusers'):assert manifest[k]==accepted[k]
 assert manifest['hardware'] and math.isfinite(manifest['model_loading_seconds'])
 assert done['completed_images']==len(done['records'])==4 and done['quality_scored'] is False
 assert read(directory/'progress.json')=={'status':'completed','completed_images':4}
 manifests.append({'chunk':chunk,'hardware':manifest['hardware'],'model_loading_seconds':manifest['model_loading_seconds'],'model':manifest['model']})
 for index,record in zip(range(start,end),done['records']):
  row=captions[index];selected=protocol['selected_prompts'][index]
  assert row['id']==selected['id']==worker.DEV_IDS[index] and row['prompt']==selected['prompt']
  assert record['prompt_index']==index and record['prompt_id']==row['id'] and record['prompt']==row['prompt']
  assert record['derived_seed']==selected['derived_seed']==worker.image_seed(row['id'],0)
  png=Path(record['png']);meta=Path(record['metadata'])
  assert png.is_relative_to(directory) and meta==png.with_suffix('.json')
  assert sha(png)==record['png_sha256'] and sha(meta)==record['metadata_sha256']
  saved=read(meta);cfg=saved['config'];old=read(selected['reference_metadata']['path'])['config']
  assert saved['complete'] is True and saved['config_fingerprint']==fingerprint(cfg)
  assert cfg['code_revision']=='06f0c87607f1750a16f8290e17e83bb71ff4ae61'
  assert cfg['implementation_sha256']==implementation_hash()
  for k in common_config_keys:assert cfg[k]==old[k],(index,k)
  assert cfg['model_revision']==worker.BASE and cfg['rope']==native_rope
  assert cfg['grid']==[64,64] and cfg['side_scale']==[1.,1.] and cfg['area_scale']==1.
  assert cfg['sega_sref_area_alternative']==1. and cfg['res']=='1024x1024'
  assert cfg['prompt_id']==row['id'] and cfg['prompt']==row['prompt']
  assert cfg['seed']==record['seed']==0 and cfg['steps']==record['steps']==28 and cfg['guidance']==record['guidance']==4.5
  assert cfg['derived_seed']==record['derived_seed']
  for k,v in worker.SCHEDULER_EXPECTATION.items():assert cfg['scheduler'][k]==v,(index,k)
  assert saved['sigmas']==record['executed_sigmas']==protocol['expected_sigmas']
  assert len(saved['gains'])==len(record['runtime_gain_audit'])==28
  for step,(hist,runtime) in enumerate(zip(saved['gains'],record['runtime_gain_audit'])):
   sigma=protocol['expected_sigmas'][step]
   assert hist['step']==step and hist['sigma']==sigma and hist['mode']=='sega_official'
   assert hist['log_g']==hist['controller_log_g']==[0.]*128
   assert hist['log_g_axes']=={'index':[0.]*16,'height':[0.]*56,'width':[0.]*56}
   assert all(hist['official'][k]==v for k,v in {'reference_qk_gain':1.,'ntk_factor':1.,'spatial_scale':1.,'spectral_spread':0.,'sigma':sigma}.items())
   assert runtime=={'step':step,'sigma':sigma,'controller_float32_all_one':True,'controller_bfloat16_all_one':True,'rotary_gain_all_one':True}
  with Image.open(png) as image:
   assert image.size==(1024,1024) and image.mode=='RGB' and image.format=='PNG'
   image.verify()
  # Re-read headers and integrity only, never display or annotate pixels.
  reference=Path(selected['reference_png']['path'])
  assert sha(reference)==selected['reference_png']['sha256']
  assert sha(selected['reference_metadata']['path'])==selected['reference_metadata']['sha256']
  with Image.open(reference) as image:
   assert image.size==(4096,4096) and image.mode=='RGB' and image.format=='PNG'
   image.verify()
  witness=record['initial_transformer_input'];wpath=Path(witness['path'])
  assert wpath.is_relative_to(directory) and sha(wpath)==witness['file_sha256']
  x=torch.load(wpath,map_location='cpu',weights_only=True)
  assert set(x)=={'initial_transformer_input'}
  x=x['initial_transformer_input']
  assert x.shape==(1,4096,64) and x.dtype==torch.bfloat16 and torch.isfinite(x).all()
  assert th(x)==witness['tensor_sha256'] and witness['shape']==[1,4096,64] and witness['dtype']=='torch.bfloat16'
  assert witness['label']=='initial_transformer_input'
  # The runtime labels this witness conservatively; independently check whether
  # it also equals the pinned CPU-seeded native FLUX packed Gaussian initialization.
  z=torch.randn((1,16,128,128),generator=torch.Generator(device='cpu').manual_seed(record['derived_seed']),dtype=torch.bfloat16)
  packed=z.view(1,16,64,2,64,2).permute(0,2,4,1,3,5).reshape(1,4096,64)
  outcomes.append({'row':index,'id':row['id'],'derived_seed':record['derived_seed'],'png_sha256':sha(png),
   'metadata_sha256':sha(meta),'initial_input_sha256':th(x),'initial_input_matches_cpu_bf16_packed_noise':th(x)==th(packed),
   'all28_sigmas_verified':True,'all28_gain_histories_and_runtime_receipts_unit':True,'native_rope_and_full_model_config_verified':True,
   'generation_seconds':record['generation_seconds'],'native_png_work_path':retained[str(png)]['preserved'],
   'old4k_png_work_path':retained[str(reference)]['preserved']})
# Only the parent-prepared input manifest is inspected, not reviewers' files.
viewer=read(notes/'reviewer_inputs.json');presentation=read(protocol['presentation']['path'])
assert len(viewer['images'])==16 and len({r['label'] for r in viewer['images']})==16
allowed={'label','caption','primary','secondary','auxiliary','exclusions','common_view','detail_view'}
view_checks=[]
for entry,mapping in zip(viewer['images'],presentation['mapping']):
 assert set(entry)==allowed and entry['label']==mapping['label']
 assert entry['caption']==captions[mapping['row']]['prompt']
 assert Path(entry['common_view'])==archive/'views'/(entry['label']+'.png')
 assert Path(entry['detail_view'])==archive/'original_views'/(entry['label']+'.png')
 assert not Path(entry['common_view']).is_symlink() and not Path(entry['detail_view']).is_symlink()
 assert Path(entry['common_view']).resolve()==Path(entry['common_view'])
 with Image.open(entry['common_view']) as image:
  assert image.size==(1024,1024) and image.mode=='RGB' and image.info=={}
  image.verify()
 source=archive/mapping['condition']/f"row{mapping['row']}.png"
 assert sha(entry['detail_view'])==sha(source)
 expected_map=next(v for v in report['viewmap'] if v['label']==entry['label'])
 assert sha(entry['common_view'])==expected_map['view_sha256']
 view_checks.append({'label':entry['label'],'neutral_paths':True,'common_shape':[1024,1024],'common_metadata_empty':True})
# Demonstrate the concrete reporter coverage issue without changing any file.
first=report['raw']['0']['completion']['records'][0]
sidecar=read(first['metadata']);changed=copy.deepcopy(sidecar)
changed['config']['model_revision']='deliberately_wrong_revision'
changed['config']['rope']['method']='deliberately_wrong_rope'
changed['config_fingerprint']=fingerprint(changed['config'])
with patch.object(worker,'read_json',return_value=changed):
 worker.validate_output(Path(first['png']),Path(first['metadata']),captions[0],protocol,changed['config'])
coverage={'confirmed':True,'mechanism':'Reporter supplies sidecar config itself as expected_config to validate_output; fully recomputed wrong model_revision and rope fields pass that helper call. No files were changed; monkeypatch only.',
 'actual_artifacts':'All eight actual sidecars independently match frozen base/Krea runtime provenance, native RoPE, seed and schedule fields. No artifact mismatch found.',

out={'reviewer':'evidence_diagnostic','status':'Actual eight artifacts and archive verified; one reporter validation coverage gap identified',
 'protocol_sha256':sha(protocol_path),'submission_sha256':sha(root/'.agent/notes/native_comparator_submission.json'),
 'report_sha256':sha(notes/'report.json'),'reporter_sha256':sha(root/'scripts/native_comparator_report.py'),
 'source_sha256':protocol['source_sha256'],'commit_bookkeeping':{'submission_source_commit':'4a12688','runtime_code_revision':'06f0c87607f1750a16f8290e17e83bb71ff4ae61','verified_git_diff':['A .agent/notes/native_comparator_preflight.json','A .agent/notes/native_comparator_protocol.json'],'interpretation':'Runtime HEAD includes only added preflight/protocol notes; frozen executable sources and implementation digest unchanged.'},'job_id':'1077304','images':8,'rows':outcomes,'chunks':manifests,
 'archive':{'path':str(archive),'files_verified':40,'retained_bytes_verified':total,'real_work_files_no_symlinks':True,
            'original_views_are_archive_hardlinks_not_scratch_links':True,'manifest_matches_work_report':True},
 'viewer_manifest':{'path':str(notes/'reviewer_inputs.json'),'images':16,'checks':view_checks,
   'condition_assignment_fields_absent':True,'per_view_paths_label_only':True,
   'scope':'Campaign root contains native_cr20 identically for all views; no per-condition path or file label leaks assignment. Original detail dimensions reveal resolution, so this is label hiding, not guaranteed blinding. No images displayed or annotated.'},
 'reporter_coverage_gap':coverage,'additional_independent_checks':['Submission job and source commit linkage; both chunk ranges/IDs/scope and model software receipts.',
 'Native per-image rotary metadata, model revision, implementation hash and controller configuration checked independently rather than trusting own config.',

 'limits':['Saved initial tensors, PNG file integrity and hashes independently verified. Model weights, internal conditioning and gain execution remain frozen-runtime receipts.',
 'No visual judgments, learned scores, causal resolution claims, image-quality method claims or novelty claims.',

 'cpu_threads':torch.get_num_threads()}
target=root/'.agent/notes/native_cr20_independent.json'
with target.open('x') as f:json.dump(out,f,indent=2,allow_nan=False);f.write('\n')
print(json.dumps({'rows_verified':8,'archive_files':40,'bytes':total,'initial_noise_matches':[r['initial_input_matches_cpu_bf16_packed_noise'] for r in outcomes],'coverage_gap':coverage,'timings':[r['generation_seconds'] for r in outcomes]},indent=2))
